skill.summary: Generates GitHub README badges using shields.io. Triggers: add badge, shields io, readme badge, status badge.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of README Badge Generator.
- Generates shields.io badges for GitHub READMEs.
- Supports trigger phrases: add badge, shields io, readme badge, status badge.
- Offers common badges for license, npm version, and CI status.
- Customizable badge colors and style options.
